class.name: IfcBSplineSurfaceWithKnots
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO 10303:42:1994 : This is a B-spline surface in which the knot values are explicitly given. This subtype shall be used to represent non-uniform B-spline surfaces, and may also be used for other knot types. All knot multiplicities except the first and the last shall be in the range 1,...., d ; the first and last may have a maximum value of d + 1. In evaluating the basis functions,
class.description: Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files.

members.member: The multiplicities of the knots in the u parameter direction. A PackedInt64Array, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The multiplicities of the knots in the v parameter direction. A PackedInt64Array, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The list of the distinct knots in the u parameter direction. A PackedFloat64Array, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The list of the distinct knots in the v parameter direction. A PackedFloat64Array, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The description of the knot type. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
